title: pkg/channel: add tests for the channel WriteCloser
body:
Adds unit tests for pkg/channel, which had no test coverage. The channel WriteCloser proxies each Write onto a chan []byte; the tests cover message queueing, the defensive buffer copy, ordering, Chan(), Close closing the channel, write-after-close failing, and the nil-receiver guard.

Pure test-only change, no behavior change. go test -race ./pkg/channel/ passes all

Fixes: #29281
